purpose: Exact SBP/DBP matching of direct patient initialisation and cardiovascular-modifier Pulse routes

multiple_solution_policy.primary_solution: accepted solution with the smallest Euclidean distance from (R=1.0,C=1.0); break exact ties by lower J, then lower R, then higher C

coupled_analysis.post_primary_factorial_sensitivity: cross direct/modifier inlet with direct/modifier global WK3 resistance scale; this attributes state-level waveform differences without changing the primary result

data_policy: Only aggregate summaries, configurations, inlets, and permitted compact traces are public. Participant-level material and full per-run Pulse traces remain private.
